'''Item Quantity''' is a [[support gem]]. It increases the [[quantity]] of items dropped by [[monster]]s killed by the supported skill. This skill gem no longer drops in the game, and can only be obtained by trading for existing ones in the [[League#Permanent Leagues|permanent leagues]].<ref>{{cite web|author=Chris|date=04 March 2013 09:47|title=1.1.0 Patch Notes - Sacrifice of the Vaal|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/810698|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|accessdate=10 March 2014}}</ref> However, it can be found as a [[foil]] in the [[Legacy league]] through Reliquary Key.{{Citation needed}}

See also: {{il|Item Rarity}}

==Skill functions and interactions==

'''Damage over time''': Increased item quantity from this gem applies also to enemies killed by damage over time effects.<ref>{{cite web|author=Chris|date=January 29, 2014 11:06 PM|title=1.0.6 Patch Notes|url=http://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/777247|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|accessdate=February 17, 2014}}</ref>

'''Containers''': The [[modifier]] from this gem does not apply to the quantity of items dropped by opening chests, strongboxes, or other containers. Mechanics that have a defined drop count are also unaffected. For example, the number of [[abyss jewel]] drops from Abyssal Troves, [[essence]]s from imprisoned monster, [[Blight (game mechanic)|Blight]] reward chests, etc, are not affected.

'''Boss drop''': While this will affect the quantity of items drops from a map boss, it will not affect the boss specific drop quantity. Fragments from guardians and conquerors, boss specific uniques and boss specific currencies are not affected by item quantity.

'''Maps''': This gem does not affect the number of [[map]]s that drop.

When linked with a skill that creates a [[minion]], [[trap]], [[mine]], or [[totem]], the item quantity modifier will apply to kills made by the minion/trap/mine/totem. This includes deaths caused by [[Minion Instability]] explosions.
